changelog:
v3.0.1 — Bug Fixes

• Fixed missing posters on Continue Watching after playing content from Search
• Fixed VOD/Series grid crash (IndexOutOfBoundsException position -1) — coalesced rapid adapter updates
• Fixed subtitles not showing in Track Picker — captions can now be turned on during playback
• Fixed garbled EPG text — no more diamond characters in program descriptions
• Eliminated double base64 decoding on cached EPG data
